assessments.reasoning: Ecma International publishes the controlling ECMA-262 15th-edition algorithm. Fresh direct acquisition returned the exact registered source SHA-256. The algorithm captures both possible inner failures, checks the input throw at step 5, and considers the inner throw only afterward. In ECMAScript 2024 IteratorClose, when the incoming completion is a throw and looking up the iterator's return method or calling it also throws, the original throw is propagated. The operation is synchronous IteratorClose with a throw Completion Record, and the return lookup or invocation yields an inner throw completion. Close can still perform observable lookup or call effects before propagating the original throw. AsyncIteratorClose is a separate operation. With a normal incoming completion, step 6 can propagate the inner throw. A successful inner call returning a non-object can reach the TypeError test in step 7 only after earlier propagation branches.
